blockers.finding: The only row write (C06) creates a new row. C08 then reads its history, and no later write changes that row before C09 restores the captured version. That version is the test-created state, not a pre-test value; a successful call would not prove restoration of changed data. The positive case is syntactically supported but does not establish the advertised rollback behavior.
blockers.source: RecordWriteWire.record_id absent means create; RecordRestoreVersionWire plus RecordStore.record_restore_version write a new version from a selected history version.

blockers.finding: The example says preview/disabled means no persistent artifact. In EnrichmentMixin.enrich_propose, run=false prevents run_enrichment, but the method still calls field_propose for a missing column and enrich_declare for the configuration. Thus the proposed case creates persistent field/enrichment rows. The report correctly marks the control blocked pending cleanup, but its expected observation is incomplete and the positive is not a no-write preview.

The positive input names field case_signature, but C11 creates only name and amount and C10 adds only case note with default text type. It also supplies neither template_id nor render_id. The source requires one document version/template and a signature-format field; without them the successful path cannot run (or may return the source's explicit approval refusal first). The procedure is correctly blocked for absent revocation, but the current positive is not a valid success fixture.
blockers.source: SignatureRequestWire and RecordStore.signature_request in packages/matrx-records/matrx_records/agent/args.py and store/client.py
